title: STNFS q12 (recover-Q): plain P10's core with exact-canonical rec7 runs (PREREG-R contamination charge), scan2/apply/recover kernels and a 2^19 filtering campaign (PREREG-G): 119.4568750535

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the algorithm of proof.md (with DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md and field-map.md) returns Q in G2 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P (g=e(P,Q0), one pairing; a=log_g z from two GT logarithms against one relation/LA phase; Q=[a]Q0; final check e(P,Q)=z; z=1 gives Q=infinity) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9; core 0.39033, audit 0.3903302934896993 after the wrapper's field-map failure term). P uniform nonidentity makes g uniform on GT minus {1}, independent of the uniform z: exactly the base/target distribution of the GT core, which is file for file the core of our plain-track P10 9c904850 (valid). Core: theta=2326/8000 sized on pool B and judged once on a fresh pool D (retained relations >= 2^63.6016, 0.0798 bits above 1.05 U); measured wide-prime and line kernels; primes in [2^56, 2^63) walked once per exact-canonical a-run (rec7; one implementation per run and band, runs of 32 to 1,024 a-values; walks only canonical slices, with the work-weighted run-contamination factor 1.0071 from PREREG-R: 0 of 600 Cc-weighted draws, 206,179 a-values, contaminated); scan2, apply and recover kernels, scan charged over every leaf length 1..64. Work on pools B, C, D with allowance 1.0119 = (1 + 2 SE)(1.0071) rounded up: collection <= 2^119.190851442 units; filtering charge N(300)/U = 0.03672 (mean + 2 SE at the two largest scales 2^18, 2^19; PREREG-G), N <= 2^58.6841, Block Wiedemann (28, 5): linear algebra <= 2^116.775787663, generator <= 2^107.389731954; 62-node lazy descent at the one-SE input 2^63.583, meter 2^113.104; rec7 bases 2^68.3; wrapper (pairings, field map, [a]Q0, check) <= 2^80 instructions = 2^66 units. Upper-rounded ledger rows including the wrapper sum to at most 2^119.45687505343, so all classical work, including preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, restarts, transfers, verification and output, is at most 2^119.4568750535 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit. {}: code identity, parameters, recorded full-run certificate, integration probes, lazy bound vs a simulation, ledger rows including the recover-Q wrapper row (80-digit) and success including the wrapper failure term. {"descent": true} also re-evaluates the descent recurrence, node counter and success. evidence16.py (local, about 4 minutes natively, not a hosted experiment) reruns every certificate and check.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py, purge target 0.0001) at relation excess 1.05 (default; optional 'excess') and the shipped means to mean weight 100, 200 or 300 (default 300) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.87) and U/N. Optional. Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
